claims.binder: (hw : ∀ n x, x ∈ s.domain → 0 ≤ w n x)

The same nonnegativity follows from hf: LocalJets.bounds gives bounds for all j ≤ m, so j = 0 yields 0 ≤ ‖f n i x‖ ≤ majorant s w α A p n x. The rest of the proof needs no sign condition: majorant_mul (WeightedClasses.lean:116) is an unconditional identity, and the Leibniz estimate comes from the public JetBounds.norm_iteratedFDeriv_bilinear_le_on. bilinear_jet_at is private, but its short proof can be copied. hw is not mentioned anywhere else in the statement, so this is a pure deletion. The statement stays true and provable without hw.
